description: This is a Dart source file defining a singleton service class 'DbService' responsible for managing local database operations related to user accounts, meals, and meal items in a diet planner and calorie tracker application. It handles database schema creation, user registration and authentication, meal management, and calorie tracking functionalities.

classes.name: DbService
classes.description: Singleton class providing database access and manipulation methods for users, meals, and meal items.

methods.name: database
methods.description: Lazy initializer for the database instance, opens the database if not already opened.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the database, creates tables, and indices if not existing.

methods.name: _hashPassword
methods.description: Generates a SHA-256 hash of the provided password.

methods.name: registerUser
methods.description: Registers a new user with email, password, and optional display name.

methods.name: loginUser
methods.description: Authenticates a user by verifying email and password.

methods.name: _ensureMeal
methods.description: Ensures a meal record exists for the given user, date, and meal type; creates one if not.

methods.name: _recomputeMealTotal
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the total calories for a specific meal.

methods.name: addMealItem
methods.description: Adds a meal item to a user's meal for a specific date and meal type, updating total calories.

methods.name: deleteMealItem
methods.description: Deletes a meal item by its ID and updates the related meal's total calories.

methods.name: getMealsByDate
methods.description: Retrieves all meals and their items for a user on a specific date.

methods.name: getDailyTotalCalories
methods.description: Calculates total calories consumed by a user on a specific date.

methods.name: getWeeklyCaloriesSummary
methods.description: Provides a 7-day summary of calorie intake ending at a specified date.

methods.name: getMealHistoryDates
methods.description: Retrieves recent dates with meal entries and total calories for a user.
